name: HFX coherence (FFT phase-agreement gate)
plain: Compares the FFT phase of the two stage slopes per frequency bin and scales the second stage's bin by 1 + η·cos(phase difference). Bins where the two stages agree are lifted and bins where they point opposite ways are cut. Levels: η 0.10, 0.30, 0.70, 1.50, capped at 10% change.
math:
Shared hfx base (all ten families): a 2-stage exponential (res_2s-style) step with c2=0.65. Symbols: x latent; σ_i current sigma; σ_{i+1} next; h = ln(σ_i/σ_{i+1}); D(·,σ) model x0 prediction; φ1(h)=(1−e^{−h})/h, φ2(h)=(e^{−h}−1+h)/h²; N steps; i step index.
E1 = D(x,σ_i) − x; X2 = x + h·c2·φ1(c2h)·E1; E2 = D(X2, σ_i e^{−c2 h}) − x.
g_i = clip((i/(N−1) − 0.25)/0.30, 0, 1)   (ramp: off for the first quarter, full from 55%); η_i = η·g_i.
F1 = rfft2(E1), F2 = rfft2(E2); c = cos(arg F2 − arg F1); E2' = irfft2(F2 · (1 + η_i c)).
In-step modes then cap the change: if rms(E2'−E2) > 0.10·rms(E2) the change is scaled down to that (whole-tensor RMS).
x ← x + h(b1 E1 + b2 E2'), b2 = φ2/c2, b1 = φ1 − b2. Last step (σ_{i+1} < 1e-6): x ← D(x,σ_i).

props.extra_model_calls: 1 per step (2 calls per step: res_2s-style base with c2=0.65)
